Source.description: Where a value came from, so guesses stay visible next to what live did.

oneOf.description: Extracted from the game client's data.
Seen in a capture of the live server (LMO_Captures.cap).
Seen in the recorded 2015 demo session.
Taken from video footage of live.
Values the server used before they were moved into content (docs/TUNABLES.md).
Proposed by a tool from client data (navmesh, names, ...), not seen live.
Placed or confirmed by someone in the world editor.

extends.description: Another record of the same kind this one starts from: its fields, then this one's on top.

feature.description:
The feature it belongs to: `live` (recreating live), `feature/...` or `other/...`.
A record with the id of one in a parent feature changes it while this feature is on.

id.description: Its id: `faction/<slug>`. Stable: other records refer to it.

rev.description: Revision, raised by every saved edit (for merging concurrent edits).

updated.description: Unix time of the last edit.
